$comment: Single source of truth for the routing/auth/rate-limit contract that EVERY gateway implementation in this directory must honour (Issue #891). gateway/scripts/check-parity.js verifies gateway/aws/cdk-stack.ts and gateway/kong/kong.yml against this manifest so the two configs cannot silently diverge. Update this file together with any intentional gateway change.

routes.$comment: Fetch a single RWA by contract id — public read
Create RWA — requires authorization in both gateways
Delete RWA — requires authorization in both gateways

waf.$comment: The WAF rate-based rule must have the same limit wherever it is defined. terraform/waf.tf references var.rate_limit_threshold, which is resolved from terraform/variables.tf by the checker.
